finalists.label: Pneumonia
finalists.why: It has multiple for evidence including cough, shortness of breath, and inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs, along with a positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test.

finalists.label: COVID-19 associated cardiac injury
finalists.why: It accounts for cough, shortness of breath, palpitations, and mild diastolic dysfunction, all of which are present in the vignette.
